text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The chairman of the World Solar Commission, Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe, said on Monday increased funding and unyielding political will were necessary for the adoption of a global system based on renewable energy sources.
- Zimbabwe has selected four renewable energy projects estimated to cost about Z$380 million for inclusion in a list of high priority national projects.
- The first phase of a Z$32 million European Union-funded water and sanitation project in Gokwe district in Zimbabwe's Midlands province is well underway.
